name: What documentation do I need to prepare for a Move-Up Buyer Program?

mainEntity.name: What documentation do I need to prepare for a Move-Up Buyer Program?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a Move-Up Buyer Program, you'll need financial documents for pre-approval, such as W-2s, pay stubs, bank statements, and tax returns. For your current home, gather property deeds, mortgage statements, recent utility bills, and any records of home improvements. Having these documents ready can significantly expedite both the listing of your current home and the loan application for your new property, allowing us to move quickly when the right opportunity arises in competitive markets like South Florida.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare financial documents for pre-approval and property records for your current home, including deeds, mortgage statements, and improvement records.
